summary: CUMYL-4CN-BINACA (also known as CUMYL-CYBINACA or SGT-78) is an indazole-3-carboxamide based synthetic cannabinoid that has been sold online as a designer drug.12 nM, respectively.1 mg in humans.

pharmacology.text: It is a potent agonist for cannabinoid receptors CB1 and CB2, with in vitro EC50 values of 0.58 nM and 6.12 nM, respectively. CUMYL-4CN-BINACA is metabolized to produce cyanide, raising concerns about liver toxicity.
